Currently, no assignment of common.cut_frame to it has been found, nor has any use of cut_frame_time_interval been found\. Additionally, this internal function segments by point count, using cut_frame_num, rather than directly splitting according to the 0\.05 seconds in the YAML\. Therefore, modifying these two YAML parameters alone will not achieve the frame splitting behavior described in the comments\.
